active.name: discharging physician
active.provenance: for_whom: 'discharging physicians'; implied by 'what the ward prescribed' and the discharge decision.

active.name: patient
active.provenance: for_whom: 'the discharged patients'; source of 'the patient's own account'; problem: 'what they were taking at home'.

active.name: community pharmacy
active.provenance: for_whom: 'the patients' community pharmacies'; holder of the community pharmacy record. Whether electronic access to this record exists is an open question in the frame.

active.name: inpatient prescribing system
active.provenance: Implied by 'inpatient prescribing records' as the system holding ward prescriptions; not explicitly named in the submission, so existence/details are assumed, not confirmed.

active.name: accountable owner
active.provenance: Frame states no owner is named; designation (e.g., head of clinical pharmacy or a named lead pharmacist for discharge reconciliation) remains an open question. Included as a flagged gap, not an invented identification.

behavioural.name: reconcile medication list
behavioural.provenance: Problem: 'Pharmacists reconcile these lists by hand' and 'ward pharmacists who perform the reconciliation' describe the same function, entered once. Currently manual across the three sources and 'skipped entirely' under time pressure; the sought change is a completed reconciliation for every discharge.

behavioural.provenance: Problem: 'community pharmacy record' is one of the three sources consulted by hand.

behavioural.name: capture patient medication account
behavioural.provenance: Problem: 'patient's own account' is one of the three sources.

behavioural.name: retrieve inpatient prescribing record

behavioural.name: prescribe inpatient medication
behavioural.provenance: Problem: 'what the ward prescribed' and 'inpatient prescribing records'.

behavioural.provenance: Problem: 'Patients are discharged with medication lists'; expected change: the discharge list must agree with the pre-admission history and the inpatient prescriptions.
